name: OnlyFans
summary: The defining creator subscription platform: unrivaled roster of mainstream pornstars and viral creators, direct messaging, and per-creator monthly feeds.
ranking_rationale: Wins on sheer creator gravity—virtually every major star and viral creator is here—despite intentionally poor internal search and pervasive agency-run PPV DMs.

pricing.model: Per-creator monthly subscriptions + PPV messages & tips
pricing.free_tier: Account signup is free; creators choose free or paid subscription pages
pricing.notes: Monthly subscription prices and PPV unlocks are set individually by each creator; check each creator's profile.

pros: Unmatched roster of top pornstars, models, and viral creators
Clean timeline interface with direct messaging and custom tips
Familiar billing and ubiquitous social-media link support
cons: Almost no built-in search or discovery feed to find new creators
Many 'free' and paid pages rely heavily on expensive PPV DM unlocks
Stricter fetish and kink content policies than Fansly or Clips4Sale
